items.title: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
items.summary: Fully automated ransomware hasn’t arrived—yet. But seemingly unsophisticated attackers are using AI tools to wreak havoc.
items.author: Matt Burgess, Lily Hay Newman
